name: x2611_14160_lem2_1_ii
statement:
(a b s : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hab : 4*b ≤ a) :
  (¬ ∃ f : Fin (1+a+b) ↪ Fin (2*(a-1)+s),
    x2611_14160_copyWeight (x2611_14160_subdividedStar a b)
      (x2611_14160_obstructionLabel a s (a+b)) f = 0) ↔ 6*s ≤ b+1
closed:
∀ (a b s : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hab : 4*b ≤ a), (¬ ∃ f : Fin (1+a+b) ↪ Fin (2*(a-1)+s),
    x2611_14160_copyWeight (x2611_14160_subdividedStar a b)
      (x2611_14160_obstructionLabel a s (a+b)) f = 0) ↔ 6*s ≤ b+1
original:
Conversely, let $a\geq 4b$ and $a,b,s\geq 1$ . For the labeling
used in (i), with $|P|=|Q|=a-1$ and $|X|=s$ , there is no zero-sum copy
of $T_{a,b}$ if and only if $6s\leq b+1$ .
type: ∀ (a b s : ℕ), 1 ≤ a → 1 ≤ b → 1 ≤ s → 4 * b ≤ a → ((¬∃ f, Mathlib2.x2611_14160_copyWeight (Mathlib2.x2611_14160_subdividedStar a b) (Mathlib2.x2611_14160_obstructionLabel a s (a + b)) f = 0) ↔ 6 * s ≤ b + 1)
